laws.k: domestic-workers|IT|National Collective Agreement on Domestic Work (CCNL Lavoro Domestico)
laws.t: National Collective Agreement on Domestic Work (CCNL Lavoro Domestico)
laws.tp: Binding pay scales, hours, rest and leave for domestic workers.
laws.s2: Skala upah, jam kerja, istirahat, dan cuti yang mengikat bagi pekerja rumah tangga.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Labor law with a special regime for domestic work and a binding national collective agreement.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
coded.n: Written letter of employment; a translation is customary.

coded.vl: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
coded.n: Minimum pay set by the national collective agreement.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Monthly pay slip and payment; limits on in-kind pay.

coded.vl: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
coded.n: 54 hours a week for live-in workers, 40 for others.

coded.vl: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
coded.n: 36 hours' weekly rest, 24 of them on Sunday.

coded.vl: Equal to or longer than for other workers

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
coded.n: Live-out or live-in; live-in accommodation must be suitable and private.

coded.vl: Worker may change employer without the employer's consent
coded.n: Work permit not tied to one employer.

coded.vl: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)

coded.n: Inspection of homes limited by the constitutional protection of the home.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
Included in the general social security system, including maternity

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.n: C190 ratified; criminal law on labor exploitation.

coded.vl: May form and join trade unions

dec.pe: Italian ships picked up Somali and Eritrean migrants at sea and took them straight back to Libya. The Grand Chamber said this broke the ban on sending people to danger and on group expulsions.
dec.pi: Kapal Italia mengangkut migran Somalia dan Eritrea di laut dan langsung membawa mereka kembali ke Libya. Majelis Agung menyatakan ini melanggar larangan memulangkan orang ke bahaya dan pengusiran kelompok.

dec.pe: Tunisian men who arrived by boat were held on Lampedusa and on ships without a legal basis, then flown home. The Grand Chamber found unlawful detention but not a collective expulsion.
dec.pi: Pria Tunisia yang tiba dengan perahu ditahan di Lampedusa dan di kapal tanpa dasar hukum, lalu diterbangkan pulang. Majelis Agung menyatakan penahanan tidak sah tetapi bukan pengusiran kolektif.
